description: This file defines inline functions and constants for the gl::Context class in the ANGLE project, related to OpenGL ES rendering. It includes buffer management, draw call handling, and state synchronization.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL context, managing rendering state and operations.

classes.name: StateCache
classes.description: Caches state related to OpenGL buffer bindings and errors.

methods.name: MarkTransformFeedbackBufferUsage
methods.description: Marks the transform feedback buffer as used after drawing.

methods.name: MarkShaderStorageBufferUsage
methods.description: Marks shader storage buffers as changed after usage.

methods.name: noopDraw
methods.description: Determines if a draw call is a no-op based on primitive count.

methods.name: syncDirtyBits
methods.description: Synchronizes the dirty bits of the context state.

methods.name: syncDirtyObjects
methods.description: Synchronizes dirty objects in the context state.

methods.name: prepareForDraw
methods.description: Prepares the context for drawing, including state synchronization.

methods.name: drawArrays
methods.description: Performs a draw arrays operation if not a no-op.

methods.name: drawElements
methods.description: Performs a draw elements operation if not a no-op.

methods.name: bindBuffer
methods.description: Binds a buffer to a specified target in the context.
